commands.name: Back
commands.description: Return to your main Stream Deck keys.

commands.name: New chat
commands.description: Start a new chat in the Claude desktop app (opens Claude if it is closed).

commands.name: Send
commands.description: Send the message in the Claude message box by pressing the app's own Send button.

commands.name: Incognito
commands.description: Open a new chat in the Claude desktop app and switch on incognito with Claude's own incognito button. Incognito chats are not saved to your history.

commands.name: Search chats
commands.description: Open Claude's search to find past chats and projects (Ctrl+K). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Usage
commands.description: Open Settings › Usage inside the Claude desktop app to see your plan limits. The plugin never reads your account data.

commands.name: Projects
commands.description: Open your Projects in the Claude desktop app.

commands.name: Recents
commands.description: Open your recent chats in the Claude desktop app.

commands.name: Claude Code
commands.description: Start a new Claude Code session in the desktop app.

commands.name: Cowork
commands.description: Start a new Cowork task in the desktop app.

commands.name: Artifacts
commands.description: Open your Artifacts in the Claude desktop app. Some Claude app versions do not open this page from a link.

commands.name: Stop
commands.description: Stop a reply that is still being written by pressing Claude's own Stop button.

commands.name: Copy reply
commands.description: Copy Claude's latest reply by pressing the Copy button under it.

commands.name: Dictate
commands.description: Bring Claude to the front and start Windows voice typing (Win+H) in the message box.

commands.name: Sidebar
commands.description: Show or hide the chat sidebar by pressing Claude's own sidebar button. If your Claude version has a sidebar shortcut, you can enter it in the key settings instead.

commands.name: More
commands.description: Show the second page of Claude keys.

commands.name: Main
commands.description: Back to the first page of Claude keys.

commands.name: Settings
commands.description: Open Settings inside the Claude desktop app.

commands.name: Connectors
commands.description: Open Settings › Connectors inside the Claude desktop app.

commands.name: Shortcuts
commands.description: Send Claude's keyboard-shortcut list key (Ctrl+/). Some Claude app versions have no shortcut list; enter another shortcut in the key settings if needed.

commands.name: Find
commands.description: Find text in the current chat (Ctrl+F). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Edit last
commands.description: Edit your last message: focuses the message box, then presses Up (Ctrl+Shift+; then Up). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Message box
commands.description: Put the cursor in the message box (Ctrl+Shift+;). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Copy
commands.description: Copy (Ctrl+C). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Paste
commands.description: Paste (Ctrl+V). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Undo
commands.description: Undo typing (Ctrl+Z). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Redo
commands.description: Redo typing (Ctrl+Shift+Z). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Zoom in
commands.description: Make Claude's text larger (Ctrl+=). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Zoom out
commands.description: Make Claude's text smaller (Ctrl+-). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Reset zoom
commands.description: Reset Claude's text size (Ctrl+0). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Full screen
commands.description: Toggle full screen (F11). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Focus app
commands.description: Bring the Claude window to the front.

commands.name: New window
commands.description: Open another Claude window (Ctrl+N). Brings Claude to the front first; nothing is sent if another window is active. You can change the shortcut in the key settings.

commands.name: Custom key
commands.description: Send any shortcut you type in the key settings, for example Ctrl+Shift+O. Win+<key> works too.
